data.body: Claimed and starting fix. Retarget decision: BOTH modules move to rebar.llm.review_code (the surviving op whose result contract is REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings — matching each test's existing assertions). review_plan returns a PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (blocking/advisory/coaching, no top-level findings), so it cannot satisfy 'result.get("findings") is not None' nor the schemas.REVIEW_RESULT + result['model'] assertions without gutting the tests. review_code is already proven live+pydantic_ai by the sibling test_pydantic_review_code in the same module. Plan: (1) test_pydantic_review_ticket_opus -> review_code on the frontier/opus model (enable REBAR_VERIFY_ENABLE_CODE_REVIEW so the real four-pass gate runs on pydantic_ai), preserving the opus param-handling intent + runner/model/findings asserts; (2) test_llm_trace.py -> review_code (capability enabled) so a real traced LLM run occurs and result.get('findings') stays assertable.
